concept.description: What the learner should notice and the representation chosen for it.

representation.description: How the described object looks and how its exact solver fields are shown by generated visuals.

palette.description: Colours readable on light and dark backgrounds.

description.description: One or two sentences in the user's language describing the scene.

code.description: A complete async function(PIXI, app, api) returning update(frame), with optional setData(), resize(width,height), pointer(event), destroy(). All artwork, layout, labels and animation are authored here; no StageKit or scene template API.

playbackRate.description: Positive simulated seconds per real second at playback 1x. Choose a suitable scale for the phenomenon; use 1 for real time. The frontend does not infer a scale.
